comment: เสียงบรรยาย 'Why Is Speed CRYING Over Ronaldo?' — ช็อต 10 และ 18 ไม่มีในนี้เพราะใช้เสียงจริงจากฟุตเทจ

segments.text: Why is this grown man CRYING over Ronaldo?
Speed sees Ronaldo — and falls in love instantly.
He even makes a whole song about him.
So he flies across the world to meet him.
Rafael Leao spots him, and stops Ronaldo's car.
He even tattoos Ronaldo on his arm.
Now 2026 — Ronaldo's LAST World Cup ever.
Backflips when he scores. Tears of joy.
Then, July 6th. Spain wins, one nil.
Ronaldo's World Cup dream is over. Forever.
Speed looks up at the big screen, and says —
Greatest fan in football history — or just content? You decide.
